entry.title: New: Bill 189 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 14, ARTICLE 25, SECTION 14-151 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO CLEARING UNSAFE FLORA

Specifies that a department designated by the mayor may investigate and certify complaints of unsafe flora and specifies that an appropriate expert may be consulted in such cases.

View on the council site
